_about: Default member copy for Settings > AI > 'Use my Claude plan' (DESIGN-SAAS.md 7.3.4). The admin can override any key in Admin > Copy (app_settings.copy_overrides). {MCP_URL} and {HOST} are filled in by the server. **bold** is shown bold.
connector_intro: Add ReelVault to your own Claude app. Your Claude then reads your reels and writes your scripts. Nothing runs until you open Claude.
connector_steps: Open Claude (claude.ai or the Claude desktop app) and go to **Customize > Connectors**.
Name: **ReelVault**. URL: {MCP_URL} (copy button). Click **Continue**, then **Continue** again.
Under Authentication, keep **Sign in now** and **Use Claude's published identity**. Click **Add**. Sign in to ReelVault and click **Allow**.
Start a new chat. Click **+**, then **Connectors**, and check that **ReelVault** is on.
Say: **Analyze my new ReelVault reels**. When Claude asks to use a ReelVault tool, click **Always allow**. If you click **Allow once**, Claude asks again for every step.
connector_notes: If ReelVault uses another AI now, click **Use my Claude plan** at the bottom of this box.
The screens differ a little between Claude accounts. Don't pick **No sign in**: then ReelVault can't connect.
Free Claude plans allow one custom connector.
On Team or Enterprise plans, your Claude owner must add it first.
Claude Code users: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user reelvault {MCP_URL}
connector_estimate_line: About 8 Claude chats to finish your first 5 competitors. Nothing runs until you open Claude. Want it faster? Add a free Gemini key just for tagging.
claude_code_command: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user reelvault {MCP_URL}
desktop_steps: Install the ReelVault desktop app on your Windows computer and sign in to Claude Code there. The steps are under **Get the desktop app** below.
In the desktop app, open **Settings** and find **Use my Claude for ReelVault Members**.
Click **Get a code** below and type the code into the desktop app.
Keep the desktop app open. It does the AI work while it runs.
desktop_install_steps: On your Windows computer, click Start, type **PowerShell** and open it.
Copy the line below, paste it into PowerShell and press Enter. It installs everything for your user only (no admin needed) and puts a **ReelVault** icon on your desktop.
When it asks, sign in to Claude Code with your Claude account (Pro or Max).
Open ReelVault from the desktop icon. In **Settings**, find **Use my Claude for ReelVault Members**.
Back here, open **Settings > AI > Use the ReelVault desktop app**, click **Get a code** and type the code into the desktop app.
key_steps: Pick a provider. Gemini has a free key in most countries.
Open the key page, make a key, and copy it.
Paste the key below and click **Test and save**. We test it before we save it.
